name: get_diagnostics_prompt
description: Get the full diagnostics prompt: how PLM/device link records work, the system-wide 'no status feedback' workflow, device-vs-IoX link table reasoning, and known fixes in order of likelihood. Call this ONCE, first, before any other diagnostic tool, at the start of any conversation that turns out to need diagnostics -- it is deliberately left out of the standing system prompt (unlike device/routine data) since most conversations never need it, so you must fetch it explicitly rather than assuming you already have it. No params.
